resources.string: Your steps become the distance travelled in an endless dungeon, whether they come from Garmin or Health Connect. 10 steps = 1 metre. Fights, guardians and chests progress without you having to play continuously.
The game is played by walking, not by staying on the screen.
Garmin uses a personal key and a 24-hour token. Health Connect reads steps recorded by Google Fit, Samsung Health or a watch. You can change source at any time in Settings.
Only one source is active at a time: no double counting.
You can adjust the text size, turn off notifications, reduce animations and export your save from the Settings screen.
Notifications can be disabled at any time.

The March of Souls reads the step count stored in Health Connect to move your character forward.

• Only the step counter is read (READ_STEPS permission).
• The last 7 days are used to catch up after an absence.
• No data is sent: nothing leaves the phone, nothing is written to Health Connect.

The game also works without this permission, with a Garmin key or without a step source.
Only days after the first connection can be credited. A day already counted is never credited twice.
